layer_3_action.subject: Mosasaurus hoffmannii
features: Solid, pitch-black silhouette with zero internal detail for a sharp 'logo' effect.
The distinctive downward-curved tail fluke is clearly defined at the top of the frame.
The blocky, powerful snout is aimed toward the bottom-right corner, creating a strong diagonal.
The pectoral and pelvic flippers are sharp and crisp, tucked close to the body.
layer_3_action.action: A 1:1 square composition featuring the Mosasaur in a high-speed, vertical breach-dive from the top-left to the bottom-right.

text_overlay.style: Bright red, 3D extruded clay-style lettering, playful bold sans-serif.
Bright red, 3D extruded clay-style lettering, larger 'bouncing' celebratory font.
text_overlay.placement: Center, angled at a 45-degree slope to parallel the Mosasaur's dive.

visual_logic.background: Vibrant, saturated sunset orange gradient with a glowing white-hot sun disk directly behind the subject.
visual_logic.lighting: Extreme rim lighting effect on the very edges of the black silhouette to separate it from the orange sky.
visual_logic.negative_constraints: No textures, no eyes, no skin detail; strictly a clean vector-style silhouette.
